Question B-001-018-004.

Why the correct answer is right: The lowest repeater output segment available to Basic-only holders is 29.500 MHz to 29.700 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "28.000 MHz to 29.700 MHz": This is the whole 10-metre band range, not the lower repeater-output segment carved out for Basic-only use.
- sourceIndex 2: "53 MHz to 54 MHz": This segment is above the low 10-metre repeater-output segment, so it cannot be the lowest segment.
- sourceIndex 3: "145 MHz to 148 MHz": This VHF segment is much higher than the 29.500 MHz to 29.700 MHz low repeater-output segment.
